messages:
elena: Quick sync — Q2 GTM priorities. We need to finalize PLG experiment slate, sales targets, and enablement dates by EOD Fri. Aero + NEX customer asks are flagged high. Input?

matt: +1. Sales prefers conservative targets for enterprise conversions. Also asking if we can push wide launch 2w to add dedicated billing docs.

sara: FYI growth slate = 1) in-app trial CTA, 2) sample prompts gallery, 3) pricing nudges. Recommend we commit to 1 & 2 for the launch window and treat 3 as an iter.

jonathan: Aero specifically needs SSO + clear private deployment messaging. If GA promises SSO, what’s realistic delivery? Customers will push contracts for it.

devon: SSO (SAML MVP) is doable but requires ~3 sprints + e2e tests. OIDC/SCIM would be stretch. If we scope MVP to SAML only we can aim mid-May.

elena: Proposal: ship SAML MVP for GA, label OIDC/SCIM as follow-ups. Marketing can arrange limited case studies targeting Aero if sales wants.

maria: Asset ask: product one-pager, 2 customer quotes, demo script, and an FAQ (SSO specifics). Can we get feature flags by May 10 to build the demo?

devon: Feature flags for sso-mvp scheduled May 5. Docs need PM inputs (PRD + acceptance criteria).

sara: I’ll own the PRD updates and will drop the docs checklist by Tue morning.

jonathan: Sales target question — are we comfortable with 20% QoQ PLG conversion lift as a goal? Or should we set a safer committed number?

matt: Set 12% committed, 20% aspirational. Also we need a clear cohort definition for measurement.

elena: Measurement definition: 7-day active trial -> paid conversion within 30 days. Growth to create dashboard and denom.

maria: Enablement plan: 2 AE playbook sessions (internal) + 1 customer webinar. Propose May 18 & May 25 for AE sessions. Ops support needed.

patrick: Ops can host the sessions but we need the final demo build 48h prior to each session (so demo frozen by May 16 for first session).

elena: Next steps recap — sara: PRD by Tue; devon: confirm SAML roadmap by Mon EOD; maria: asset list by Wed; matt/jonathan: confirm sales target wording by Wed. Reconvene Thu 9am. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled: feature-flag rollout `sso-mvp` -> 2026-05-05T02:00:00Z

maria: noted — I'll start draft one-pager today and align with sales quotes asap.

elena: Thanks all. If anyone has blocking dependencies, ping me directly and I'll escalate.
